categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 24 - Bananas All The Way Down

locations.title: 22 - Peeled from Peel Peak

locations.title: 21 - Battle: Three-Tiered Tussle

locations.title: 25 - Shifty Smash: The Rotating Ring
locations.description: Found when hitting a prism in the cave, then destroying all the concrete blocks within 20 seconds.

locations.title: 30 - Gold-Dipped Banana
locations.description:
In the room below a ring of spiky ball dispensers.

_Tip: Clap to raise a protective ring of dirt around the hole, then transform to break the material covering it._

locations.title: 29 - The Flying Banana
locations.description: On the underside of a floating platform that spews spiky balls all over the area.

locations.title: 17 - Thorny-Hill Finish Line
locations.description: Reward for completing the [Thorny Hill Speed Surf](#loc=466229).

locations.title: 18 - Thorny-Hill Buzzer Beater
locations.description:
Reward for completing the [Thorny Hill Speed Surf](#loc=466229) with 20 seconds or more left on the clock.

_Tip: Use the narrow paths and jump over obstacles!_

locations.title: 19 - Thorny-Hill Hideaway
locations.description: Behind the wall near the exit barrel at the end of the [Thorny Hill Speed Surf](#loc=466229).

locations.title: 15 - Hilltop Smashin' Stats
locations.description: Speak to the 'Smashintone' on the platform after smashing 20,000 cubic metres of stone in this layer.

locations.title: 16 - Bloomed in the Hilltop Layer
locations.description:
Given to you by the plant pot creature when you destroy the nearby stone that's blocking the light.

_Tip: If the last chunk of stone is just out of reach, throw rocks to break it._

locations.title: 26 - Against the Oncoming Tide
locations.description: Beneath an archway found soon after entering the [Spiked-Tide Slope](#loc=466240)

locations.title: 27 - Against the Winding Tide
locations.description: In front of the exit barrel from the [Spiked-Tide Slope](#loc=466240)

locations.title: 28 - Amidst the Hidden Tide
locations.description: Underneath the exit platform in the [Spiked-Tide Slope](#loc=466240). Use one Boom Bomb to empty the spiky ball pit, and the other to destroy the concrete blocking the mesh on the ceiling. You'll then be able to climb the wall behind you and climb over to the gem.

locations.title: 34 - Tunneling through the Pit
locations.description: Behind a concrete wall halfway down the pit.

locations.title: 36 - Over the Valley
locations.description: Halfway through [Nostalgia Country](#loc=466246).

locations.title: 37 - Hijinxs in the Jungle
locations.description: At the end of [Nostalgia Country](#loc=466246)

locations.title: 35 - Treasured Memories
locations.description: Inside DK's house, above the entrance once you're inside [Nostalgia Country](#loc=466246). Pile up some rocks or perform a Chunk Jump to start climbing and reach it.

locations.title: 31 - Hilltop Quiz Master
locations.description:
**Location:** Given to you by Quiztone, found on a large blue banana. Answer the three questions correctly - answers listed below - to receive the banana.

- What do you need before you can buy new fashions at any Style Shop?
    - Fossils
- What did you lose when Void Kong first arrived and attacked Ingot Isle?
    - Your helmet
- What's an unexpected alternate use for the gold bullion you can unearth?
    - Throwable explosive

locations.title: 32 - Cranky's Hilltop Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by Cranky Kong, found on a floating platform. Throw a chunk of terrain at him from the top of the nearby blue banana and have a chat to receive the Banandium Gem.

locations.title: 13 - Battle: Spike-Spout Scrap
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Hilltop Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=466687)

locations.title: 23 - The Skies over Peel Peak
locations.description: **Location:** On a floating platform above the highest point of Peel Peak. Throw a chunk of terrain to bring it crashing down.

locations.title: 02 - Cave-Dwelling Treasure
locations.description: **Location:** Deep underground. Follow the Fractone that keeps popping out of the ground to reach it.

locations.title: 11 - Hilltop Fragmentone Recovery
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for bringing the first fragmentone back to its larger counterpart. You'll find it in the cave, a few steps away.

locations.title: 12 - Hilltop Fragmentone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for bringing all three Fragmentones back to their larger counterpart. You'll find them inside the cave, where they await behind a wall, on a ledge, and at the bottom of a crater.

locations.title: 08 - A Shifty Path Forward
locations.description: **Location:** [Shifty Platform Road](#loc=466701) - found after riding the first two moving platforms.

locations.title: 10 - Make-Your-Own Platforms
locations.description:
**Location:** [Shifty Platform Road](#loc=466701) - found after the section with moving platforms and thorns.

_Tip: Don't activate all the platforms at once - they disappear after a few seconds!_

locations.title: 09 - An Out-of-the-Way Room
locations.description:
**Location:** [Shifty Platform Road](#loc=466701) - when you reach a section with thorns and four moving platforms, peek over the side to find a secret platform. 

_Tip: Pull a chunk out of the platform to break the thorns hiding this banana!_

locations.title: 14 - Hilltop Hide-and-Seek
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for finding (and breaking) four Fractones disguised as nearby terrain. 

You'll find two in the concrete, one in the nearby crevice, and one at the edge of the platform.

locations.title: 20 - Shifty Smash: Break the Canopy
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Shify Smash Challenge](#loc=466710)

locations.title: 07 - The Shifty Path under the Village
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath the platform. Throw a chunk of terrain at the shifty block to create a platform and access the banana.

locations.title: 33 - Shifty Smash: Downhill Run
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shify Smash Challenge](#loc=466725)
